# chrome.webNavigation

The navigations of the documents of tabs and of their frames (src/page/ext_webnavigation.odin). Frame ids are Chrome's: 0 for the tab's top document, -1 for no parent. A document's URL is given only to an extension that may see it (the tabs permission or a host grant); the events of other documents are not sent to it.

Gate: permission `webNavigation`; contexts: Background, Popup, Tab. Source: `api/ext_webnavigation.widl`.
